_comment: Original BF16/FP16 safetensors -> Heretic one-click jailbreak -> target=auto verified quantizer. Requires pip install -U heretic-llm (torch + transformers). Heretic runs in its own console window; when it finishes, choose Save the model to a local folder and paste <output_dir>/intermediate/heretic. TurboForge waits for the saved weights and then continues quantization automatically; if heretic exits without saving, the build fails honestly. NVFP4/GGUF inputs are refused. The source directory is never touched.
